result.title: EviBridge: Encoding Predictive Visual Evidence for Proactive Interaction
result.summary: Tool-handover interaction calls for preparation before a response is warranted. The model waits until interaction cues appear, then prepares while assessing whether the accumulating evidence supports a response or calls for cancellation. We introduce EviBridge, a framework that integrates predictive visual representations into a vision-language interaction model for joint state and tool prediction. A trainable evidence interface maps features from a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder into the language decoder alongside native visual inputs, preserving their temporal context and using only observations available at each decision time. The framework has two instantiations. EviBridge-E distinguishes recent from historical evidence and encodes the timing and spatial location of each observation. EviBridge-I preserves the temporal order of pooled V-JEPA 2 features and interaction turns and generates dedicated interaction tokens. We evaluate on FuGIBench, a streaming-video benchmark for preparation, response, and cancellation in tool-handover assistance. The best-performing variants of EviBridge-E and EviBridge-I achieve Overall scores of 0.6448 and 0.5892, compared with 0.2178 and 0.5327 for their respective task-adapted native baselines. These gains span target handovers, long waits, and cancelled requests, demonstrating the value of predictive visual evidence for interaction decisions.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 EviBridge 框架，将冻结 V-JEPA 2 编码器的预测性视觉特征经可训练「证据接口」注入视觉语言解码器，在流式视频中联合预测交互状态与工具，并判断证据是否足以响应或应取消；在 FuGIBench 上以两种实例化（E 区分近期与历史证据并编码时空位置，I 保留特征与轮次时序并生成交互 token）取得明显提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据接口」把预测性视觉 latent 保留时序送入解码器、并在交互决策中判断证据是否充分（响应/等待/取消），与 LVR 关注的视觉证据保留、STOP 决策及证据筛选直接相关，可供核查 latent 注入方式与停止判据；但任务目标是交互时机而非显式推理轨迹生成。
